partition: same four previously consumed obstacle-enabled track-1 TRAIN roads used by both 100k learners; not fresh, blind, confirmation or official evaluation
model_selection: Only the first complete episode-boundary checkpoint >=100k, and default MPPI as PRIMARY mode, were predeclared before treatment outcomes. Prior is separately secondary.
source_reward_target: replay training_reward = raw environment reward - 5 * positive cumulative damage increment; evaluation uses only unmodified raw environment reward
comparison_limits: Compared on the same four heavily trained road/reset CELLS, not identical action/state trajectories. MPPI finishes 2/2 on one road and 0/2 on each of the other three; prior finishes 0/8. Raw-target frozen baseline MPPI finished 0/8. Aggregate shaped MPPI progress and raw return are higher than the raw-target baseline, but one road's per-cell progress is lower and mean MPPI damage remains 0.45 in BOTH studies; no general damage suppression is demonstrated. The first planned RAW and DAMAGE training actions already differed at decision10001 before a positive damage penalty occurred. A one-seed comparison cannot identify damage shaping as the cause of two local finishes; repeats of one geometry are not eight independent roads. CPU latency is an internal runtime proxy, not official package compliance. This 2/8 fails the predeclared >=4/8 descriptive local goal, and even 4/8 on these repeatedly trained roads would not establish independent or private-track generalization.
decision: Keep this source-bound one-axis study intact, do not promote to official model or claim >=50% full-episode completion. The fixed raw H3 branch-ranking dataset does not supply matching shaped truth and cannot rank the shaped head against it. Before any separately pinned H5 horizon or MPPI sample-axis reset, examine source-bound model-only H5 reward/terminal/discount calibration without using protected roads and predeclare any new branch/evaluation cells and a single changed planner variable. Future H5 training must return to the original raw-target 100k baseline unless an explicitly different incremental study isolates shaping-plus-H5. Fresh multi-track TRAIN-DIAGNOSTIC audit remains BLOCKED and the lower-tier reused cross-lane development option is not a fresh generalization claim.
